name: floa
description: FLOA — the engine in src/, one folder per business in businesses/. build.mjs renders each business into its own site.
//imports: The engine's public surface. A business under businesses/ imports the shared
components, layouts and helpers through these names and NEVER through a
relative path — a business must not know how deep it sits, or where src/ is.
Node resolves them natively (package.json subpath imports); there is no
bundler and no build step behind this.
//test: `npm test` is everything that needs nothing but node: where a lead lands,
the chord model, and the assembly of a read sheet into a song.
`npm run test:layout` drives a real Chrome over dist/ to check that a chord
sits on its syllable in both directions, which is the one thing about this
that cannot be checked by reading it. It needs a build first, and it passes
with a note where there is no browser to drive.
`npm run test:stack` drives one too, and presses back: a page that was left
has to come back as the same nodes, at the same height, without asking the
//hooks: core.hooksPath is stored per clone, not in the repo, so a fresh checkout
commits with no protection at all. `npm run hooks` turns .githooks on;
it is one command and it only has to be run once per machine.

scripts.test: node worker/test/lead.test.mjs && node worker/test/transcribe.test.mjs && node worker/test/geometry.test.mjs && node worker/test/page.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/model.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/names.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/ear.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/follow.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/credits.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/played.test.mjs && node businesses/chords/test/costs.test.mjs
scripts.cv: node build.mjs && node scripts/gen_cv_pdf.mjs && node build.mjs
